query_raw: How long should cool running water be applied to a burn?
query_normalized: How long should cool running water be applied to a burn? (burns scalds cool running water first aid)

generation_raw.text:
According to NHS guidelines, you should hold a burn or scald under cool running water for 15 to 30 minutes, or until the pain feels better [1]. If running water is not available, you can use cool bottled water instead [1].
